name: m4-uniques-census-uncache

variantDescriptions.kw: `claude/uniques-audit` `41986b33ea`, chunked-weak, census on (weak scopes tagged, everything interned)
variantDescriptions.kwu: the same, with `-Dscala.uniques.uncache=all`: types made in the weak scopes are not added to the table

description: Top-line uniques counts for one scala-corpus compile before and after uncache: types added to the table, their fates, and in the uncache variant how many lookups in the weak scopes were served by the table, by the direct-mapped cache, or returned uninterned. Counters are over every compile of the fork; divide by runs.
